name: Redline Crucible Crawlers
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Redline Crucible Crawlers. Low SIX-LEGGED furnace gun platform, insectlike riveted machine with broad armored crucible belly, exactly three articulated piston legs on each side, long red-hot pressure rail cannon pointing right from top, two molten vents, hammered bronze plates and charcoal joints. No humans, no riders. Idle: 1 cannon points nearly horizontal, leg pistons relaxed; 2 cannon elevates slightly at turret joint and front leg knee joints bend while feet stay planted; 3 cannon at higher resting angle, middle leg pistons compress and vent lids lift; 4 cannon halfway lowers and leg pistons return. Maintain six complete feet, same chassis shape and full long barrel in every frame.
reference_use: Original generation based on approved unit upgrade design brief.
